zh: ML-DSA：模格上的数字签名算法。
lattice-based：基于格问题的构造类别。
approved：§2.1 只定义这一个术语——FIPS-approved 与/或 NIST-recommended，三种可判定来源之一。
signature key pair：只应用于签名的密钥对。
acceptable level of security：由部署方负责的整体安全水准。
Module Learning With Errors：§1 给出的 ML-DSA 困难问题依据。
en: ML-DSA: the module-lattice digital signature algorithm.
Approved: the single defined term in §2.1 — FIPS-approved and/or NIST-recommended, via one of three sources.
Signature key pair: keys reserved for signing use.
Acceptable level of security: the whole-system bar owned by the deployer.
Module-Learning-With-Errors: the hardness assumption clause 1 gives for ML-DSA.
